(i) the IB theory of deep learning does not hold in the general case and instead is a function of the specific neural nonlinearity used; (ii) the IB theory can be used to explain why deep networks generalize well in the case of linear activation functions; and (iii) the IB theory cannot be used to explain the generalization behavior of deep networks with saturating activation functions.
